items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: One of the earliest guys that wrote on jazz in New Orleans, of course, was Preston Jackson.

ctx.x: As a matter of fact, Leroy Jones wrote an article, wrote a chapter in his book, Blues People, talking about jazz. He called it Jazz and the White Critics. He wanted to point out the fact that jazz, as a black art, not exclusively, but in large part in some respects. It's always been brought to the attention by white critics.
One of the earliest guys that wrote on jazz in New Orleans, of course, was Preston Jackson. That's right.
I was thinking about that, too.
